pressure_hypothesis.title: A known campaign session cannot be selected when project continuations conflict
pressure_hypothesis.basis: A second authenticated reproduction, captured by a different Environment recorder session, required the exact registered Compiler worktree context after project-root selection reported multiple registered worktrees. The context-bound read succeeded. Two subsequent successful reads recorded measured Control dispatch elapsed times; those values include session-queue wait and do not establish cause.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: When a caller already knows a session identity, let Control resolve that exact authenticated session or return the exact required registered worktree context. Continue validating principal, campaign, Environment definition, workspace, checkout identity, lifecycle, and claim authority before selection.
